test_title: PYST 30: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 5 Oct 2021 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: A retailer opens her outlet on all seven days of the week. It is observed that her average sales for Saturdays and Sundays combined is Rs. 300, and Rs. 200 for the remaining five days combined. For a month starting on a Saturday, it was found that the total sales were Rs. 7,000. Which among the following months it could be?
solution: Given: The retailer opens her outlet on all seven days of the week. Her average sales for Saturdays and Sundays combined are Rs. 300, and Rs. 200 for the remaining five days combined. For a month starting on a Saturday, it was found that the total sales were Rs. 7,000. Concept used: If a month starts with Saturday, that month must have 5 Saturdays and 5 Sundays. (Except February)
